name: "Setup Swamp"
description: "Download and install swamp, optionally authenticate with swamp-club.com and initialize a repository"
branding:
  icon: "terminal"
  color: "green"

inputs:
  version:
    description: "Swamp version to install (default: stable)"
    required: false
    default: "stable"
  api-key:
    description: "API key for authenticating with swamp-club.com (set as SWAMP_API_KEY env var)"
    required: false
  swamp-club-url:
    description: "Override the swamp-club.com server URL (default: https://swamp-club.com)"
    required: false
  repo-init:
    description: "Run swamp repo init after setup"
    required: false
    default: "false"

outputs:
  version:
    description: "The version of swamp that was installed"
    value: ${{ steps.verify.outputs.version }}

runs:
  using: "composite"
  steps:
    - name: Install swamp
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
      run: |
        INSTALL_DIR="${RUNNER_TEMP}/swamp"
        mkdir -p "${INSTALL_DIR}"

        curl -sSfL https://swamp-club.com/install.sh | sh -s -- \
          -V "$INPUT_VERSION" \
          -d "$INSTALL_DIR"

        echo "${INSTALL_DIR}" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

    - name: Verify installation
      id: verify
      shell: bash
      run: |
        VERSION=$(swamp --version)
        echo "version=${VERSION}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        echo "Installed swamp ${VERSION}"

    - name: Mask and set SWAMP_API_KEY
      if: inputs.api-key != ''
      shell: bash
      env:
        SWAMP_API_KEY: ${{ inputs.api-key }}
      run: |
        # Reject values containing newlines to prevent GITHUB_ENV injection
        if [[ "$SWAMP_API_KEY" == *$'\n'* ]]; then
          echo "::error::api-key must not contain newlines"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "::add-mask::${SWAMP_API_KEY}"
        echo "SWAMP_API_KEY=${SWAMP_API_KEY}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

    - name: Set SWAMP_CLUB_URL
      if: inputs.swamp-club-url != ''
      shell: bash
      env:
        SWAMP_CLUB_URL: ${{ inputs.swamp-club-url }}
      run: |
        # Reject values containing newlines to prevent GITHUB_ENV injection
        if [[ "$SWAMP_CLUB_URL" == *$'\n'* ]]; then
          echo "::error::swamp-club-url must not contain newlines"
          exit 1
        fi
        # Validate URL scheme
        if [[ "$SWAMP_CLUB_URL" != https://* ]]; then
          echo "::error::swamp-club-url must use https://"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "SWAMP_CLUB_URL=${SWAMP_CLUB_URL}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

    - name: Verify authentication
      if: inputs.api-key != ''
      shell: bash
      run: |
        AUTH_STATUS=$(swamp auth whoami --json | jq -r '.authenticated')
        if [ "$AUTH_STATUS" != "true" ]; then
          echo "::error::Authentication failed"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "Authentication verified successfully"

    - name: Initialize repository
      if: inputs.repo-init == 'true'
      shell: bash
      run: |
        swamp repo init

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

# Supersede in-flight runs for the same ref. Safe here because CI only reads —
# nothing it does is destructive or partially observable if cancelled.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

# Single source of truth for the Deno version. Referenced by every setup-deno
# invocation AND by the actions/cache key so bumping this one value stays
# consistent across both. Hardcoding the version in the cache key while
# bumping only setup-deno's input would produce a permanent silent regression:
# the cache would hit on the old key (skipping the save of the new binary),
# setup-deno's tc.find would miss on the new version, and every run would
# re-download from the CDN forever. One string, one diff line to review.
env:
  DENO_VERSION: "2.9.7"

jobs:
  discover:
    # Derive the extension matrix from the filesystem. On pull requests, scope
    # to extensions touched by the diff plus their reverse dependencies. On push
    # to main or workflow_dispatch, run the full matrix unconditionally.
    name: quality ${{ matrix.extension }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        extension: ${{ fromJson(needs.discover.outputs.extensions) }}
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ${{ matrix.extension }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      # Pinned to the v0.1.0 commit SHA — a mutable tag could be redirected to
      # code with full runner access to the Bedrock token and the Deno cache.

# Pre-Push Review Loop

Run a local adversarial review on uncommitted or unpushed changes. Iterate

After making changes and before pushing to a remote branch. Especially

- Fixes to prior adversarial review findings (regression risk is high)
- Concurrent-access code (locks, sequences, distributed state)
- Any change touching error handling or fallback paths

`runBigQuery` (around line 1657) loops on `page.jobComplete === false`.
